capabilities: Open a system terminal at the current note's directory
Add context menu entries in the file explorer and editor
Run the 'Open terminal here' command from the command palette
Select a terminal app per platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
Configure a custom terminal command using a {dir} placeholder
extras: The manifest description carries the unreviewed-plugin notice: 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.'
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open a shell session in the folder containing the note you are working on.
summary: Terminal launcher that opens a system terminal at the directory of the current note via command palette or context menus.
